steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); })()

steps.name: place-grid
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = [ ['sofa-3seat',{}], ['sofa-3seat',{armStyle:'armless'}], ['sofa-2seat',{}], ['sofa-lshape',{}], ['sofa-lshape',{chaiseSide:'left'}], ['dining-chair',{}], ['dining-chair',{style:'upholstered'}], ['office-chair',{}], ['office-chair',{style:'executive'}], ['office-chair',{style:'mesh'}], ['bar-stool',{}], ['bar-stool',{style:'pedestal'}], ['bar-stool',{style:'backed'}], ['bench',{}], ['bench',{style:'storage'}], ['bench',{style:'slat'}], ['armchair',{}], ['armchair',{style:'wingback'}], ['armchair',{style:'tub'}], ['ottoman',{}], ['ottoman',{shape:'square'}], ['ottoman',{shape:'rect'}], ['chaise-lounge',{}], ['dining-table-4',{}], ['dining-table-4',{seats:'8'}], ['dining-table-4',{shape:'round'}], ['dining-table-4',{shape:'oval',seats:'6'}], ['desk',{}], ['desk',{legStyle:'legs'}], ['desk',{legStyle:'hairpin'}], ['coffee-table',{}], ['coffee-table',{shape:'round'}], ['coffee-table',{shape:'oval'}], ['console-table',{}], ['console-table',{style:'drawers'}], ['bar-cart',{}], ['bar-cart',{tiers:3}], ['side-table',{}], ['side-table',{shape:'square'}], ['side-table',{shape:'drum'}] ]; const cols = 8; const dx = 1.5, dz = 2.0, x0 = 1.2, z0 = 1.2; const pos = {}; const list = items.map(([defId, props], i) => { const c = i % cols, r = Math.floor(i / cols); const x = x0 + c * dx, z = z0 + r * dz; const key = defId + ':' + JSON.stringify(props); pos[key] = [x, z]; return { id: 'audit-' + i, defId, position: [x, z], rotation: 0, props }; }); window.__auditPos = pos; s.setItems(list); return list.length; })()

steps.name: frame-lshape
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['sofa-lshape:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.45, p[1]], radius: 1.7 }); })()

steps.name: frame-chaise
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['chaise-lounge:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.4, p[1]], radius: 1.3 }); })()
